about: Every in-game bug report (bug-reports branch, reports/<ts>-<id>/) that was a gameplay or logic bug, mapped to the test that guards it. status: new = added by this suite; covered = an earlier fix already has a test; pending-pr = its test is in an open PR; live-regression = the test fails on the current head and is held as XFAIL in tests/regression/test_regressions.py (KNOWN_LIVE) until the fix lands. Fixtures are the reporters' saves copied verbatim.

issues.description: AI Scribe free cast resolved nothing
issues.note: The save in the report is empty ({}), so the existing synthetic test from #55 is the guard.

issues.description: Duel: human outbid twice and the turn ended
Familiar gather and its cast read as two Newt turns
issues.note: One move (summon Vulpes for gather, cast Mana Drain) logged cast-first. Fixed by #115 and #116.

issues.description: Tower cost ignored Perfect Reagent / Inexpensive
AI with the lead did not build the last tower to win
issues.note: As saved Newt trailed 48-54, so not ending the game was right (passes). With Newt leading 48-26 the master lookahead still picks research over the winning build (XFAIL 118-lead).

issues.description: AI turn ended after losing its own auction
AI gave up after two lost bids
Familiar New Research showed one spell, not four
Rise did not let the player pick a familiar
issues.note: Keith owned no familiar, so Rise had no target (correct). The test also gives him one and checks the pick and use flow.
